cases.objective: Verify the valid guarded submission transition and persistence effect.

steps.action: Request submit; inspect resulting state and persisted submitted_at.
steps.expected: State becomes SUBMITTED and submitted_at is persisted.

cases.title: Owner submits from DRAFT

cases.objective: Verify cancellation changes state without side effects.

steps.action: Record existing data and side-effect observables, request cancel, and compare the resulting state and observables.
steps.expected: State becomes CANCELLED with no side effect.

cases.title: Cancel from DRAFT

cases.objective: Verify terminal-state cancellation preserves state and persisted data.
preconditions: Persisted data has been recorded before the request.

steps.action: Request cancel and compare state and persisted data with their recorded values.
steps.expected: The transition is invalid; state remains SUBMITTED and persisted data remains unchanged.

cases.title: Reject cancellation from SUBMITTED

cases.objective: Verify the explicitly stated undefined-event request preserves state.

steps.action: Request archive and inspect state; record any persisted-data or other side effects for specification review.
steps.expected: The request is invalid and state remains DRAFT. Persisted-data and other side-effect expectations are unspecified.

cases.title: Reject undefined archive request from DRAFT

cases.objective: Verify the failed owner guard preserves state and persisted data.
preconditions: Persisted data has been recorded before the request.

steps.action: Request submit and compare state and persisted data with their recorded values.
steps.expected: The transition is invalid; state remains DRAFT and persisted data remains unchanged.

gaps.description: The archive rule specifies unchanged state but does not specify persisted-data or other side-effect behavior.
gaps.impact: The archive candidate cannot assert absence of side effects beyond preservation of DRAFT.
gaps.needed_evidence: An explicit side-effect and persisted-data invariant for an archive request from DRAFT.

gaps.impact: Invalid candidates assert the stated state and data invariants without inventing a response status, message, or schema.
gaps.needed_evidence: The response contract for terminal-state, undefined-event, and failed-guard requests.

invalid_candidates.reason: archive is not a defined event.
invalid_candidates.side_effect_expectation: Unspecified beyond unchanged state; see G-STT-001.

summary: Draft design covers two valid and three invalid transition candidates. No tests were executed or baseline approved.
